Android Software Engineer – Intelligent Cockpit / IVI
May 20, 2026
Bucharest, Romania | Full-time | On-site
 About The Role
 We are a global automotive Tier1 supplier focused on intelligent cockpit and domain controller platforms. We are currently building a new European R&D center in Bucharest to support next-generation cockpit programs for leading European OEMs.
We are looking for an Android Software Engineer with experience in automotive infotainment systems or embedded Android platforms. You will be involved in the development and integration of Android-based IVI systems, working closely with system, BSP, and hardware teams to deliver production-ready cockpit solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain Android-based software for in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) systems
Participate in system design and integration across Android framework, HAL, and middleware layers
Work on Android Automotive OS (AAOS) or customized Android platforms for automotive use
Collaborate with BSP, system, and hardware teams to ensure stable and efficient system integration
Analyze and resolve system-level issues related to performance, stability, and resource usage
Participate in requirement analysis and technical discussions with internal teams and customers
Optimize system performance (boot time, memory usage, threading, IPC, etc.)
Support debugging and issue resolution during development and validation phases
 Mandatory Requirements
5+ years of Android development experience (Java/Kotlin)
Hands-on experience in automotive software projects, especially in IVI / infotainment / cockpit domain
Strong understanding of Android system architecture (Framework, Binder, HAL, Services)
Experience with multi-threading, IPC, and system performance optimization
Familiar with Linux-based systems and embedded development environments
Fluent English for technical communication in an international team
 Technical Qualifications
Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) or customized Android IVI platforms
Familiarity with HAL development, system services, or framework-level development
Understanding of BSP integration and interaction with lower-level components
Knowledge of vehicle communication interfaces (CAN, Ethernet) is a plus
Experience with debugging tools (logcat, systrace, perf tools, etc.)
Familiar with modern Android architecture patterns when applicable
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with automotive OEMs or Tier1 suppliers
Experience in cockpit domain controller or multi-ECU systems
Knowledge of C/C++ for native or lower-level components
Familiarity with QNX or hybrid systems is a plus
Experience with performance tuning or system optimization in production projects
 Why Join Us
Opportunity to be part of a newly established European R&D center
Work on next-generation cockpit and domain controller platforms
Direct exposure to European OEM projects and real production programs
Opportunity to grow into system, architecture, or technical leadership roles
